# OpenNetwork design tokens — Kotlin (Android, Compose Multiplatform desktop)

- `ai.nddev.opennetwork.design.tokens`: every value, no dependency (colours ARGB, dimensions dp, text sp).
- `ai.nddev.opennetwork.design.compose`: `NDDevTheme` maps the roles onto Material 3 (colour scheme and typography) and provides `LocalNDColors`, `LocalNDMetrics`, `LocalNDPlatform`, `LocalNDScript`.

```kotlin
NDDevTheme(theme = NDTheme.Light, direction = NDDirection.On, families = { appFonts(it) }) {
    Text("NDDev", style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineLarge, color = LocalNDColors.current.textPrimary.toCompose())
}
```

- Fonts: IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Sans Arabic (OFL-1.1) are class-path resources listed by `NDBundledFonts`; Compose desktop loads them with `Font(resource = …)`, an Android app copies them into `res/font` (lower-case names). Chinese and monospace use the system faces.
- Android: add `src/main/kotlin` to a module's sources and depend on `androidx.compose.material3:material3` (the same API). The contrast themes follow `UiModeManager.getContrast()`; `NDMotion.Reduced` follows an animator duration scale of 0.
- Icons and the mark: `Icon(NDIcon.Arrow.imageVector, contentDescription = null, tint = …)`; `NDBrand.mark.toImageVector("nddev", 48.dp)`.
- Shapes: `NDDevTheme` passes `ndShapes(metrics)` to `MaterialTheme`, so Material components take the kit's field, chip, card and dialog radii (ADR 0006).
- Desktop: include this directory as a Gradle build (`build.gradle.kts` compiles it against Compose Multiplatform Material 3 and runs the tests).

Consume a release: copy this directory from the tag `vX.Y.Z` into the product and record the tag and the directory digest (docs/adr/0001-architecture.md §13). Never edit the copy; update it from a newer tag.
